title: Friars Inn, Paley's band, Midway Gardens and Steve Brown
summary: Discussion of the Friars Inn job of Mares and Brunies, Rinker's place in Bill Paley's band with Caffarelli, and Midway Gardens leaders including Steve Brown, Elmer, Floyd Town and Charlie Straight.
